post.description:
Before showing the "choose your password" form: whose link is it, and does
it still work?
Use an invite or reset link: set the password, end other sessions, sign in.

A draft goes live: its page opens to anyone with the link (A24: from the
project page's staff bar). Publishing twice changes nothing.

schema.title: Response Detail Types Api Detail Types Get

put.description:
The page shows one meeting, the next: this sets it (a new one, or the
upcoming one changed).
A stage's note to the client ("Recado"); empty removes it.

post.description: At the end: a built-in stage (not already in the project) or the office's own.

patch.description: A built-in stage renamed becomes the office's own, keeping its description.

delete.description:
The stage leaves the page; its folder and files stay in Drive. The stages
after it move up, and their folders are renumbered.

post.description: Swap with its neighbour. The current stage stays the same stage.

Advance to the next stage, go back one, complete the project (all stages
done) or reopen it. The client sees it at once; "Atualizado" moves.
The file stays in Drive, renamed "_name", which the page doesn't show.
The client types the project's password once per device (A06).
